newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's government hopes BOS will lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Spain's government hopes BOS will lower rates.

text.p: Spain's Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday he hopes the central bank will cut the official money market rate this week following the presentation of an austere 1997 budget.
"Nobody can dash the market trend," which has already discounted lower rates, Montoro told reporters after a parliamentary meeting.
Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar's government presented its 1997 budget to parliament on Monday, considered the strictest in 20 years. Approval is expected before year-end.
The Bank of Spain last cut the repo rate to 7.25 percent on July 4. The next repurchase agreement is set for Thursday.
